redCandidate.setup: The local adapter test requests the pinned Hermes model with a usage-file path and a task containing a sentinel expected answer. No executable is invoked.
redCandidate.expected: The public factory returns a Hermes one-shot invocation using deepseek-v4-pro and the given usage path while omitting the sentinel answer.
redCandidate.observed: The test exits with code 1 because the current factory rejects Hermes as unconfigured.
redCandidate.failureReason: The existing adapter supports Codex and Claude only; Hermes has no command-construction branch.
